correctness.rationale: For every fixed Lambda subset of {M,C,N,K}, propositional SAT/TAUT give the lower bounds. Nishimura's singleton completeness construction supplies a polynomial-size one-point witness. The only apparent obstacle, infinite closure under repeated conjunction, is eliminated by a relevance lemma: a C-created conjunction outside the finite subformula-relevant set cannot add new relevant facts through later M, and M/C never create implications used by K. Restricted saturation therefore computes all closure facts needed to evaluate the input in polynomial time, yielding NP satisfiability and coNP validity/theoremhood.
